title: lint-all --no-stand-down (measurement runs)
summary: lint-all --no-stand-down stays off the maintenance channel, so a peer's stand-down cannot cut a measurement run to PARTIAL
intro: Read this when you time or compare lint-all runs on a machine where other sessions may ask engines to stand down: --no-stand-down makes lint-all ignore the maintenance channel for that run, so it always completes (or fails on its own). The cost: the stand-down verb no longer lists or stops that run.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint lint-all --db <file.sqlite> --no-stand-down (do not open the maintenance control channel: a stand-down request cannot cut the run to PARTIAL, exit 4; it is not listed by the stand-down verb either)
